sections.text: Keep 3-5 years of living expenses in debt funds (lower returns, lower tax). Set up an STP to transfer a fixed amount monthly from debt to equity funds. Run your SWP from the debt fund. This way, your equity allocation continues to grow for the long term while your short-term withdrawals come from the more stable debt portion.

Debt fund withdrawals are taxed at your income slab rate but only on the capital gains portion. By keeping 3-5 years of expenses in debt, you avoid having to sell equity units when markets are down. The STP ensures your equity allocation is gradually built back up over time.
